description:
I'm a fourth-year student at Thuyloi University (TLU), passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, and space exploration. I have hands-on experience solving computer vision and machine learning problems, and I enjoy turning innovative ideas into practical solutions.

I'm looking for enthusiastic teammates with skills in software development, data analysis, UI/UX design, or geospatial technologies. Let's combine our strengths to build something creative and impactful!
